conviction_note: No unpriced company-level number found. findings.finding: On the Q2 call (2026-08-13) management guided YORVIPATH to 'growth and performance consistent with prior quarters' on a steady ~1,000 new US patients a quarter. Recent increments: Q3'25 143 -> Q4'25 187 (+44) -> Q1'26 197 (+10, seasonal/free drug) -> Q2'26 252 (+55). Continuing the trend puts Q3 YORVIPATH near EUR 295-305m and product revenue near EUR 360-375m against a total-revenue consensus of about EUR 365-372m, so the bar is roughly on trend and this lands inside what the company already guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-13): revenue beat by about 11.5% (USD consensus $353.8m vs $394.4m) and the stock gained +2.31%, $244.20 to $249.85 (fxempire). Q1 2026 (2026-05-07): a YORVIPATH miss (EUR 197m; Cantor flagged a FactSet consensus of $253m) and the stock 'slid', magnitude unsourced. The baseline's 8-event history is non-earnings 6-Ks and unusable.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The company told the market to expect this, and the consensus already sits near the trend extrapolation. If the market expected a summer stall, consensus would sit below Q2 plus the trend increment, and it does not. The only unpriced part is the residual, in either direction, from US summer seasonality, which management declined to address.
findings.independence: Q2 release figures: https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/ASND/ascendis-pharma-q2-2026-financial-results. Q4'25 figures: https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/ascendis-pharma-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results. Both are company documents from the same issuer, so this is one line of evidence.

findings.finding: BioMarin's Q3 2026 release (2026-11-02, after Ascendis last spoke) shows Voxzogo children treated up 17% y/y, down from more than 20% in Q1-Q2. More than 75% of Voxzogo revenue now comes from outside the US, and most US new starts were children under two, the age group YUVIWEL is not approved for (2+). That is a counterparty read-through that YUVIWEL is taking US new starts in the 2+ group. YUVIWEL had 220+ US enrollments by end-July, Q2 revenue EUR 7.6m, and 20% US royalty to BioMarin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior YUVIWEL surprise. It was in its first quarter at EUR 7.6m in Q2, and the stock gained +2.3% on that print.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. BioMarin's call was covered as an order-timing story (a delayed international order, a $25m Voxzogo guide-midpoint cut), not as a US share shift. If ASND holders had read it as a YUVIWEL beat, I would expect a move in ASND around Nov 2-3; the 5-day run-up is -0.2%. YUVIWEL is about 5% of product revenue, so the rest of the company has to come in on trend for this to matter. Sized net of that.
findings.independence: This is a proxy, and the only direct counterparty. https://stockstory.org/us/stocks/nasdaq/bmrn/news/earnings-call/bmrn-q3-deep-dive-pipeline-expansion-and-order-timing-weigh-on-guidance (2026-11-03) confirms the slowdown to 17% with growth led internationally.

findings.finding: The 2026-08-31 binding term sheet with BioMarin sets a 20% royalty on US YUVIWEL net sales, retroactive to first sale, and 18% in the EU, Brazil and Korea to May 2030. Q3 is the first quarter it hits cost of sales, including a catch-up on Q2's EUR 7.6m. That is a small gross-margin drag of roughly EUR 4-6m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on this line. The settlement itself drew no separately sourced reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: The terms are public, so it is largely priced. Only the accounting presentation is unknown (a catch-up in COGS against a separate line). Sell-side models may not have put the retroactive piece into Q3 margins. Below operating income relevance is small.
findings.independence: BioMarin's 8-K restates the same terms: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001048477/000104847726000021/earningsrelease-2nov26ex991.htm. It is the same agreement, so one fact.

findings.finding: EUR/USD weakened through Q3, ending September near 1.135 after a more than 2% monthly fall; the Q3 average was roughly 1.15-1.16 by my inference. Most YORVIPATH revenue is USD, so a weaker euro raises reported EUR revenue. I could not source the Q2 average, so the sign of the quarter-on-quarter translation effect is unresolved.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The company has flagged FX as a factor in reported revenue (Q4'25 call) without quantifying it. No past reaction is attributable to FX.
findings.why_not_priced: Sell-side models update FX routinely, so it is likely priced. A USD consensus (Benzinga $420m) and a EUR one (about EUR 372m) would already embed different rates. Filed at 0 because the quarter-on-quarter comparison is unsourced.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-14 Ascendis regained TransCon metabolic/cardiovascular rights, including once-monthly TransCon semaglutide, from Novo Nordisk and authorised a $400m buyback. The stock fell 9.49% on the cost of running those trials alone, with a Raymond James downgrade. The Q3 call is the first place management can quantify 2027 R&D for these programmes, and a higher opex trajectory is the line holders sold in September.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-09-15: -9.49% close-to-close on the strategic reset (non-earnings). Before that, the Q2 call's opex message ('significant operating leverage') coincided with +2.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The September move priced a generic cost fear without a number. The stock has since recovered (+13% over 20 days, 7% off its high), so the market has partly stopped discounting it. A quantified, larger-than-feared 2027 R&D step-up would be new, and so would a reassuring 'within existing opex' line, which is why the range is wide in both directions. The buyback's Q3 execution (EUR 103m in H1 under the old $120m programme) offsets part of it.
findings.independence: https://tickerspark.ai/market/ascendis-pharma-a-s-asnd-falls-13-on-strategic-reset-1789484792879 (same event, intraday -13%). Same fact, not independent.
